resolutions.researcher_notes: IMPORTANT CORRECTION to the deep-sweep audit's Capacity concern for this row: that concern compared the sheet's 107.00 MMSCMD against the WRONG column of the SAME regulatory report -- the 'Authorised Capacity' figure (111.3 MMSCMD) printed in the report's OPERATIONAL-COMMON-CARRIER-PIPELINE listing table (page 2). This report ALSO carries a second, separate table ('NGPL UNDER REGULATION 17 (MMSCMD)', page 6) whose 'Design/Determined Capacity (MMSCMD)' column gives the GAIL/Integrated HVJ row as exactly 107.0 -- an EXACT match to the sheet's Capacity=107.00/CapacityUnits=MMSCMD, confirmed locally with pdftotext -layout. This is independently corroborated by a second PNGRB webpage, the 'Pipeline Open Access (Schedule I)' capacity declaration for Integrated HVJ (as of 1 Dec 2019): 'NAME OF PIPELINE: Integrated HVJ ... SECTION WISE CAPACITY ... CAPACITY (MMSCMD): 107' -- also confirmed locally. Flagging tier=medium/independent=false rather than high: the Schedule I document's own footnote states this 107 MMSCMD figure derives from a single GAIL letter to PNGRB dated 14.02.2011 (Letter No. INFRA/PL/EXIS/17/DVPL-GREP-UPGR/GAIL/01/10), so both PNGRB documents ultimately trace to one GAIL-declared origin, not two independent measurements -- consistent with the sweep's standing India caveat that GEM's numbers and PNGRB largely share lineage. Note this value is the shared HVJ-GREP-DVPL SYSTEM total (identical across all 5 component rows P0919/P0925/P3297/P3298/P3299), not this segment's own throughput, per the deep-sweep audit's prior finding -- unaffected by this correction, which concerns only which PNGRB table the number traces to.

Could not find a source supporting the sheet's LengthKnown=770.00 km for this specific segment. Three sources found instead DISAGREE with each other and with 770: (1) GAIL's own 27.11.2018 letter to PNGRB, Annexure-A para 1.4 (OCR-confirmed by the deep-sweep audit) states DVPL-I is specifically '42"x612 Km' (Vemar, Gujarat to Vijaipur, M.P.); (2) offshore-technology.com/GlobalData gives '710km-long'; (3) neither PNGRB's current monthly register nor its Schedule-I capacity declaration itemises DVPL-I's length alone -- both report only the combined 6-pipe 'Integrated HVJ' system total (6,169 authorised / 6,732 operating km), confirmed locally with pdftotext -layout on both PDFs. Global Energy Observatory's record (geoid/40893) does not expose a saved length value in its scraped HTML (dynamic form, values not present in the static markup). Per the deep-sweep audit's own prior finding, the spread across the three itemised figures (612-770 km) is ~26%, too large to be rounding, and I found no fourth source to break the tie. Per standing rule 2/3, not proposing a ref for a value none of my sources actually state; this is a value disagreement that routes to Update, not a ref-sweep fill. Searched: GAIL/gailonline.com, PNGRB tariff orders (pngrb.gov.in/pdf/orders/), business press (Business Standard, ET Energy) for a DVPL-I-specific length figure -- none found beyond the three already on record.
